verses.2: You thought it was a just judgment. You said, “It’s righteous from God.”
verses.3: For if he says, “What will harm you? What can be done about my sin?”
verses.4: I will answer you from behind, and your friends will be with you.
verses.5: Look up at the heavens, and see that there are clouds high above you.
verses.6: If I have sinned, what will be done to me? And if my crimes become too many, what will be done to them?
verses.7: If you are righteous, then what will you give him? Or who will take it from you?
verses.8: To a man like you, who is evil; and to a human being, who is righteous.
verses.9: Many troubles will arise, but they will be resolved from the midst of many difficulties.
verses.10: And he did not say, “Who is this god who sings songs in the night?”
verses.11: Let them wait for us from the mountains of the earth, and from the heights of heaven.
verses.12: There they would cry out, but no one would answer them in response to their evil cries.
verses.13: But they will not listen; their voices will not be heard.
verses.14: Even if he says, “Do not judge us before him,” and “Do not condemn us.”
verses.15: And now, since Ain has been punished, and he doesn’t know anything about it.
verses.16: And Eiyov Habel will spread his mouth without knowing what he’s doing.
